note: Starting points for the Environment section. Each preset selects sources and bounded overrides validated by disturbance_parameters.validate_settings; sources a preset does not list keep the repository defaults. Wind vectors are world XYZ (Z up), noise is one standard deviation in observation units, COM bounds are metres in body FRD. Presets with group 'imu' model a specific IMU/AHRS: they set only the sensor_noise section, and the editor applies them without touching wind or COM. The simulator adds independent Gaussian noise per 30 Hz control step (tvc_env/envs/observations.apply_sensor_noise), with no bias or correlation model, so each datasheet figure is mapped to one white-noise sigma: attitude_std = the published pitch/roll error (dynamic when published, else static), angular_velocity_std = gyro noise density x sqrt(15 Hz) (the control loop's Nyquist band) when a noise density is published, else the published gyro accuracy/stability figure. None of these parts measures position or velocity to landing precision, so position_std and velocity_std stay at the repository defaults (0.01 m, 0.05 m/s), i.e. an external source such as motion capture or RTK.

presets.name: BNO085 (hobby)
presets.summary: CEVA BNO085 9-axis SiP, game rotation vector: 2.5 deg attitude, 3.1 deg/s rate.

hardware.source: CEVA BNO08X datasheet (rev 1.16/1.17), fusion performance table; values from vendor datasheet excerpts
hardware.mapping: attitude_std = game rotation vector dynamic error 2.5 deg (no magnetometer: the EDF's high-current bus, limited at 120 A, disturbs it); angular_velocity_std = calibrated gyroscope accuracy 3.1 deg/s (no noise density is published).

presets.name: WITMOTION WTGAHRS1 (hobby)
presets.summary: WT901B-based AHRS + GPS: 0.05 deg static attitude, 0.05 deg/s gyro stability. Static spec only.

hardware.type: AHRS (WT901B) with GPS/BeiDou and barometer, Kalman filter, 0.2-200 Hz output
hardware.source: WTGAHRS1 datasheet v20-0615, section 3.1 Measurement Range & Accuracy
hardware.mapping: attitude_std = X/Y angle accuracy 0.05 deg, which the datasheet gives only as a static inclinometer figure, so in-flight error will be larger (measure it); angular_velocity_std = gyro stability 0.05 deg/s. The built-in GPS (2.5 m) is not modelled: it exceeds the 0.5 m noise bound and the 0.5 m landing criterion.

presets.name: VectorNav VN-110E (tactical)
presets.summary: Tactical-grade embedded IMU/AHRS: 1.0 deg dynamic attitude, 5 deg/hr/sqrt(Hz) gyro noise.

hardware.type: Embedded IMU/AHRS, no GNSS, 800 Hz IMU rate
hardware.source: VectorNav VN-110 / VN-110E product brief and datasheet; values from vendor datasheet excerpts (navtechgps.com/vn-110e)
hardware.mapping: attitude_std = pitch/roll dynamic accuracy 1.0 deg RMS; angular_velocity_std = 5 deg/hr/sqrt(Hz) x sqrt(15 Hz) = 0.0054 deg/s.
